svg.title: Optical amplifier — inline symbol
svg.desc: Editable, annotation-free optical amplifier symbol matching the component library. A right-pointing triangle represents amplification from the left input to the right output. The input and output fibers have pale gray cladding, blue cores and no outer outlines, matching the simplified bandpass-filter component. The muted rose triangle is a functional symbol, not a physical device layout or an emitted wavelength. It does not specify an amplifier technology, gain value, noise figure, bandwidth, pump arrangement or power supply. Geometry is schematic and has no physical scale. All elements are native editable SVG on a transparent background. Fiber connections and the amplifier symbol are separate Inkscape layers.
